data.long_meaning: Shvetank is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'shvet' (white, pure) and 'ank' (support, strength). It is a name that signifies purity, cleanliness, and intelligence. The name Shvetank carries the meaning “White, Pure, Clean” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Shvetank usually hope their child will grow to embody white, pure, clean and live with faith, good character and purpose.
